meaning.en: Being at peace inside, free from worry or agitation.
meaning.zh: 心里安宁平和，没有烦恼和波动。

examples.zh: 练了几年瑜伽后，她变得内心平静，很少为小事发火。
examples.en: After a few years of yoga she has found inner peace and rarely loses her temper over trifles.

examples.zh: 无论外面多么嘈杂，他总能保持内心平静。
examples.en: However noisy it is outside, he can always keep his mind calm.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or 保持/获得 + 内心平静; describes a state of mind rather than outward manner.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“保持内心平静”，指心理状态而非外表。

literal: not at all · have no · waves · billows

meaning.en: Without any ripple of change or emotion; completely calm, sometimes to the point of dullness.
meaning.zh: 一点起伏变化也没有，形容心情或局面非常平静，有时带有平淡、无动于衷的意思。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她的心里毫无波澜。
examples.en: On hearing the news, she felt not a ripple of emotion.

examples.zh: 这几年的生活毫无波澜，每天都是上班、回家。
examples.en: Life these past years has been without a ripple: work, then home, every day.

usage.en: Predicate, often 心里/生活/日子 + 毫无波澜; can sound detached or flat depending on context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“心里/生活毫无波澜”，可指镇定，也可指平淡或冷漠。

meaning.en: Good-looking and tall with a strong, upright bearing (of a man).
meaning.zh: 相貌英俊，身材高大挺直（多形容男子）。

examples.zh: 他是个英俊挺拔的小伙子，一进场就吸引了不少目光。
examples.en: He is a tall, handsome young man who drew many eyes the moment he walked in.

examples.zh: 照片里的父亲年轻时英俊挺拔。
examples.en: In the photo, my father was handsome and erect in his youth.

usage.en: Mostly describes young men; usually an attributive (英俊挺拔的青年) or predicate.
usage.zh: 多形容男青年，常作定语或谓语。

meaning.en: Shining so brilliantly that it catches the eye.
meaning.zh: 光芒和色彩鲜明夺目，十分醒目。

examples.zh: 红毯上的明星们个个光彩耀眼。
examples.en: The stars on the red carpet were all dazzling.

examples.zh: 阳光下，金色的屋顶显得光彩耀眼。
examples.en: In the sunlight the golden roof looked dazzlingly bright.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can describe objects, places or people who shine.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，既可形容物，也可形容人。

meaning.en: A scene that looks desolate, lonely and sad.
meaning.zh: 眼前的景色冷清荒凉，使人感到悲伤。

examples.zh: 战争过后，村子里一片废墟，景象凄凉。
examples.en: After the war the village lay in ruins, a desolate sight.

examples.zh: 深秋的荒野景象凄凉，不见一个行人。
examples.en: The late-autumn wilderness was a bleak scene, without a single passer-by.

usage.en: Usually a predicate after a description of the place; somewhat written in tone.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常接在对场景的描写之后，略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: Made with great care and delicate workmanship.
meaning.zh: 制作的手艺精巧细致。

examples.zh: 这件景泰蓝花瓶工艺精细，价值不菲。
examples.en: This cloisonné vase is exquisitely crafted and worth a lot.

examples.zh: 苏绣以工艺精细著称。
examples.en: Suzhou embroidery is famed for its delicate workmanship.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (工艺精细的…); common in product descriptions and museum guides.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，常见于产品介绍和展览解说。

meaning.en: Lacking firmness of will; easily giving in under pressure or temptation.
meaning.zh: 意志力不强，遇到压力或诱惑容易动摇、放弃。

examples.zh: 他意志软弱，一遇到困难就想退缩。
examples.en: He is weak-willed and wants to back out at the first difficulty.

examples.zh: 意志软弱的人很难戒掉坏习惯。
examples.en: Weak-willed people find it hard to break bad habits.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (意志软弱的人); a criticism of character.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，是对性格的批评。

meaning.en: To get rid of what stands in the way so that things can go ahead.
meaning.zh: 把阻碍事情进行的东西清除掉。

examples.zh: 新政策的目的是为中小企业消除障碍。
examples.en: The new policy aims to remove obstacles for small and medium-sized firms.

examples.zh: 工程师们花了三天才消除障碍，让列车恢复通行。
examples.en: It took the engineers three days to clear the obstruction and reopen the line.

usage.en: Verb-object; the object can be physical or abstract (语言障碍, 制度障碍).
usage.zh: 动宾结构，宾语可以是具体或抽象的障碍，如语言障碍、制度障碍。

meaning.en: Fine rain falling so lightly that the air looks misty.
meaning.zh: 雨丝细小，天色迷蒙。

examples.zh: 清明时节，细雨蒙蒙，路上行人稀少。
examples.en: At Qingming it drizzled in a mist and few people were out on the road.

examples.zh: 细雨蒙蒙的早晨，湖面上飘着一层薄雾。
examples.en: On the drizzly morning a thin mist hung over the lake.

usage.en: Descriptive; used as a predicate or an attributive (细雨蒙蒙的夜晚). Slightly literary and scenic.
usage.zh: 描写天气的常用词语，可作谓语或定语，略带书面和诗意色彩。

meaning.en: Lacking vitality and energy; dull and listless.
meaning.zh: 没有活力和朝气，显得死气沉沉。

examples.zh: 这个团队长期缺乏生气，大家都在混日子。
examples.en: The team has lacked vitality for a long time; everyone just coasts.

examples.zh: 房间里的陈设单调，显得缺乏生气。
examples.en: The furnishings were drab, and the room felt lifeless.

usage.en: Predicate, often after 显得; applies to people, places, organisations or writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用在“显得”之后；可指人、地方、团体或文章。

meaning.en: To act against one's own sense of right and wrong.
meaning.zh: 做出违反自己道德判断的事。

examples.zh: 他不愿说违背良心的话，所以辞去了职务。
examples.en: He refused to say what went against his conscience, so he resigned.

examples.zh: 为了赚钱而违背良心，我做不到。
examples.en: I cannot go against my conscience just to make money.

usage.en: Verb-object, often 做/说 + 违背良心的事/话.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常说“做违背良心的事”“说违背良心的话”。

meaning.en: A chance combination of circumstances that brings something about.
meaning.zh: 由于偶然的机会和各种条件恰好凑在一起。

examples.zh: 我们俩机缘巧合，在异国的小镇重逢。
examples.en: By a happy coincidence the two of us met again in a small foreign town.

examples.zh: 这份工作是机缘巧合才得到的。
examples.en: I got this job through sheer coincidence.

usage.en: Often an adverbial or predicate (因为机缘巧合); usually has a pleasant tone.
usage.zh: 常作状语或谓语，如“因为机缘巧合”，多含美好的意味。

meaning.en: Examined so thoroughly that the heart of the matter is laid bare.
meaning.zh: 分析得深入全面，把问题的本质讲清楚了。

examples.zh: 专家对市场走势分析透彻，大家听后都很信服。
examples.en: The expert analysed the market trend so thoroughly that everyone was convinced.

examples.zh: 这篇评论分析透彻，一针见血。
examples.en: This commentary is thorough and goes straight to the point.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (分析得透彻); a praise for reports, comments, reasoning.
usage.zh: 作谓语或补语（分析得透彻），多用来称赞报告、评论、推理。

meaning.en: Skilled at thinking ahead and working out a plan.
meaning.zh: 擅长事先考虑、制定计划和办法。

examples.zh: 她善于谋划，每个项目都安排得井井有条。
examples.en: She is a skilled planner and every project runs in good order.

examples.zh: 善于谋划的人往往能在竞争中占得先机。
examples.en: People who plan well often gain the upper hand in competition.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; positive, can apply to people or organisations.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，褒义，可用于个人或组织。

meaning.en: Quick and fluent in speech; ready with words.
meaning.zh: 说话流利敏捷，应对自如。

examples.zh: 这位主持人口齿灵活，现场气氛很热烈。
examples.en: The host has a quick tongue, and the atmosphere was lively.

examples.zh: 小姑娘口齿灵活，大人们都爱和她聊天。
examples.en: The little girl talks nimbly and the grown-ups love chatting with her.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for speakers, salespeople, children.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多用来称赞主持人、销售员、孩子等。

meaning.en: Having a grave, serious manner; not joking or casual.
meaning.zh: 神情和做法认真庄重，不随便、不开玩笑。

examples.zh: 老师态度严肃地批评了迟到的同学。
examples.en: The teacher criticised the latecomers with a stern manner.

examples.zh: 谈到安全问题，他的态度严肃起来。
examples.en: When it came to safety, his manner turned serious.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (态度严肃地…); not necessarily negative.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（态度严肃地……），不一定含贬义。

meaning.en: Showing respect and taking great care in how one acts.
meaning.zh: 对人有礼貌，做事小心慎重。

examples.zh: 他对长辈恭敬谨慎，从不失礼。
examples.en: He is respectful and careful with his elders and never fails in manners.

examples.zh: 新来的助理做事恭敬谨慎，深得领导信任。
examples.en: The new assistant works respectfully and carefully and has won the boss's trust.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often describes conduct toward superiors.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，多描写对上级、长辈的态度。

meaning.en: To hold firmly to one's moral principles and integrity, whatever the pressure.
meaning.zh: 在压力或诱惑面前始终坚持自己的品德和操守。

examples.zh: 面对巨额诱惑，他依然坚守节操。
examples.en: Faced with a huge temptation, he still held to his integrity.

examples.zh: 这位老教授一生坚守节操，从不趋炎附势。
examples.en: The old professor stood by his principles all his life and never fawned on the powerful.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal, often in praise of a person's moral character.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，较庄重，多用来赞扬人的品格。

meaning.en: Quick to notice and judge things accurately; keen of eye and mind.
meaning.zh: 观察事物敏感而准确，眼力好、判断准。

examples.zh: 这位编辑目光敏锐，总能发现有潜力的新作者。
examples.en: The editor has a keen eye and always spots promising new authors.

examples.zh: 目光敏锐的投资者早早就看出了这个行业的前景。
examples.en: Sharp-eyed investors saw this industry's prospects early on.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; literal and figurative.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，既可指视力，也可指洞察力。

meaning.en: Not good at dealing with people or making social connections.
meaning.zh: 不擅长与人来往，不会应酬。

examples.zh: 他性格内向，不善交际，朋友不多。
examples.en: He is introverted, not good with people, and has few friends.

examples.zh: 不善交际的人也可以在工作中做得很出色。
examples.en: People who are not good at socialising can still do excellent work.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; mild and fairly neutral, more a description than a criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，语气较温和，偏描述而非批评。

meaning.en: Huge waves slamming against the shore.
meaning.zh: 巨大的浪涛猛烈拍打着岸边。

examples.zh: 海边惊涛拍岸，声如雷鸣。
examples.en: Waves crashed on the shore, thundering like drums.

examples.zh: 台风来临前，惊涛拍岸，渔船都已回港。
examples.en: Before the typhoon, the surf pounded the shore and the fishing boats were already back in port.

usage.en: Descriptive of sea or river scenery; literary, famously from Su Shi's 念奴娇·赤壁怀古.
usage.zh: 描写江海景象，书面语，苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》中有“惊涛拍岸”。

meaning.en: Skilled at leading and coordinating others toward a goal.
meaning.zh: 擅长带领和调度别人完成任务。

examples.zh: 这位教练善于指挥，球队在场上配合默契。
examples.en: The coach directs well, and the team plays in perfect step.

examples.zh: 善于指挥的队长能让每个人发挥所长。
examples.en: A captain who commands well lets each person use his strengths.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used for army officers, managers, coaches, conductors.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，可指军官、管理者、教练、乐队指挥等。

meaning.en: Thoughts that are jumbled and cannot settle.
meaning.zh: 想法杂乱，静不下心来。

examples.zh: 考试前一晚，她思绪纷乱，怎么也睡不着。
examples.en: The night before the exam her thoughts were in a whirl and she couldn't sleep.

examples.zh: 听到那个消息后，他思绪纷乱，一时不知如何是好。
examples.en: After hearing the news his thoughts were in a tangle and he didn't know what to do.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows a cause (听到…后思绪纷乱) and can precede 难以入睡.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常在某个原因之后出现，后面可接“难以入睡”等。

meaning.en: Walking with a strong, springy and energetic step.
meaning.zh: 走路有力、敏捷，显得精力充沛。

examples.zh: 八十岁的爷爷每天清晨脚步矫健地去公园晨练。
examples.en: At eighty, grandpa still walks briskly to the park every morning for exercise.

examples.zh: 运动员脚步矫健，一眨眼就冲过了终点线。
examples.en: The athlete's stride was powerful and he crossed the finish line in a flash.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (脚步矫健地走来); often used for older people who are healthy.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语；常用来形容身体硬朗的老人。

meaning.en: Handling affairs honestly and decently, without underhand methods.
meaning.zh: 做事光明正大，不搞歪门邪道。

examples.zh: 他行事正派，在同行中口碑很好。
examples.en: He acts uprightly and has a good name among colleagues.

examples.zh: 行事正派的人不用担心别人说闲话。
examples.en: Those who conduct themselves decently need not worry about gossip.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (行事正派的人); sometimes 为人正派 is used about character.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（行事正派的人）；说品性时也可说“为人正派”。

meaning.en: Working or going on without ever seeming to tire.
meaning.zh: 一直做下去，好像从不感到累。

examples.zh: 志愿者们不知疲倦地奔走在灾区。
examples.en: The volunteers worked tirelessly across the disaster area.

examples.zh: 孩子们在海边不知疲倦地追逐嬉戏。
examples.en: The children chased and played on the beach without ever tiring.

usage.en: Mostly adverbial (不知疲倦地…) or predicate; usually admiring, or affectionate about children.
usage.zh: 多作状语（不知疲倦地……）或谓语，多含赞赏，说孩子时带亲切意味。

meaning.en: Clean in money matters and upright in character; free of corruption.
meaning.zh: 不贪污、不谋私利，品行端正。

examples.zh: 人民需要廉洁正直的好官。
examples.en: The people need honest, incorruptible officials.

examples.zh: 他一生廉洁正直，两袖清风。
examples.en: He was incorruptible all his life and left office with clean hands.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typically for officials and public servants; fairly formal.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多用于官员和公职人员，较庄重。

meaning.en: To live or work together in a warm, harmonious way.
meaning.zh: 彼此来往关系和谐，没有矛盾。

examples.zh: 我和室友相处融洽，从来没红过脸。
examples.en: My flatmate and I get along well and have never had a quarrel.

examples.zh: 同事之间相处融洽，工作起来也更愉快。
examples.en: When colleagues get on well, work is more pleasant too.

usage.en: Predicate; note 相处 uses chǔ (to get along). Often 与……相处融洽.
usage.zh: 作谓语，注意“处”读 chǔ；常说“与……相处融洽”。

meaning.en: Serious and conscientious in approach; taking things earnestly.
meaning.zh: 对待事情庄重而不马虎。

examples.zh: 医生对待每个病人都严肃认真。
examples.en: The doctor treats every patient with serious care.

examples.zh: 这是一项严肃认真的工作，容不得半点马虎。
examples.en: This job is a serious matter that cannot be done carelessly.

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial or attributive; shows a responsible attitude to work or study.
usage.zh: 作谓语、状语或定语，表示对工作、学习负责的态度。

meaning.en: Able to weigh matters and make up one's mind quickly and rightly.
meaning.zh: 擅长在关键时刻做出果断而正确的决定。

examples.zh: 一个好的领导者必须善于决断。
examples.en: A good leader has to be decisive.

examples.zh: 她善于决断，会议上很快就定下了方案。
examples.en: She is good at making decisions and the plan was settled quickly in the meeting.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for managers and leaders.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多用来称赞领导者。

meaning.en: Planned in detail so that nothing is overlooked.
meaning.zh: 计划制订得细致全面，没有疏漏。

examples.zh: 这次行动谋划周密，几乎没有出现任何意外。
examples.en: The operation was planned meticulously and hardly anything went wrong.

examples.zh: 谋划周密的方案赢得了评委的好评。
examples.en: The carefully laid plan won praise from the judges.

usage.en: Predicate, complement (谋划得周密) or attributive.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、补语（谋划得周密）或定语。

meaning.en: Easy to get to and from, with good transport links.
meaning.zh: 来往方便，交通条件好。

examples.zh: 这个小区交通便利，步行五分钟就到地铁站。
examples.en: The estate has convenient transport, five minutes' walk from the metro.

examples.zh: 交通便利是吸引外资的重要条件。
examples.en: Good transport links are a key draw for foreign investment.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; very common in property adverts and city descriptions.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常见于房产广告和城市介绍。

meaning.en: Skilled at meeting and getting along with all kinds of people.
meaning.zh: 擅长与人交往，人缘好。

examples.zh: 她善于交际，到哪里都能很快交到朋友。
examples.en: She is good with people and quickly makes friends everywhere.

examples.zh: 做销售的人最好善于交际。
examples.en: Salespeople had better be good with people.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; positive, common in job descriptions.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，褒义，常见于招聘要求。

meaning.en: A setting that is peaceful and out of the way.
meaning.zh: 周围的环境安静、清幽，少有喧闹。

examples.zh: 这家民宿环境幽静，适合来度假放松。
examples.en: The guesthouse is in quiet surroundings and ideal for a restful break.

examples.zh: 学校选在环境幽静的郊外，便于学生专心读书。
examples.en: The school was built in a quiet suburb so students can concentrate.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used for homes, hotels, parks, study spots. Note the two 静/幽 words describe stillness.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于住所、酒店、公园、读书的地方等。

meaning.en: Friendly contact and exchanges between people, groups or countries.
meaning.zh: 彼此友好地来往交流。

examples.zh: 两国人民世代友好往来，感情深厚。
examples.en: The two peoples have had friendly exchanges for generations and share deep feelings.

examples.zh: 我们学校与海外高校保持着友好往来。
examples.en: Our school keeps up friendly exchanges with overseas universities.

usage.en: Often in news and diplomacy (保持/开展友好往来); also used between schools, cities and companies.
usage.zh: 常见于新闻和外交语境（保持/开展友好往来），也用于学校、城市、企业之间。

meaning.en: To work together in a close, well-coordinated way.
meaning.zh: 彼此配合得很紧，联系密切地合作。

examples.zh: 两家公司紧密合作，共同推出了新产品。
examples.en: The two companies worked closely together to launch the new product.

examples.zh: 医生和护士紧密合作，才能抢救病人。
examples.en: Doctors and nurses must cooperate closely to save a patient.

usage.en: Usually adverbial or a verb phrase (紧密合作); common in business and news.
usage.zh: 常作状语或动词短语，常见于商务和新闻。

meaning.en: Having a nimble mind that adapts easily and finds ways round problems.
meaning.zh: 思维灵活，善于变通，反应快。

examples.zh: 他头脑灵活，遇到问题总能想出办法。
examples.en: He is quick-witted and can always think of a way round a problem.

examples.zh: 做生意要头脑灵活，不能死守老办法。
examples.en: In business you need a nimble mind, not stubborn old methods.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praises flexibility of thinking.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，称赞思维灵活变通。

meaning.en: Reacting quickly and correctly to what happens.
meaning.zh: 对出现的情况反应迅速。

examples.zh: 守门员反应敏捷，扑出了这个点球。
examples.en: The goalkeeper reacted quickly and saved the penalty.

examples.zh: 她反应敏捷，立刻回答了记者的提问。
examples.en: She responded quickly and answered the reporter at once.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for people, animals or systems.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，可指人、动物或系统。

meaning.en: Having rules that are strict and consistently enforced.
meaning.zh: 纪律严格而清楚，赏罚分明。

examples.zh: 这支部队纪律严明，所到之处秋毫无犯。
examples.en: The unit is strictly disciplined and harmed no one along the way.

examples.zh: 纪律严明的球队才能在逆境中不乱阵脚。
examples.en: Only a well-disciplined team can keep its shape under pressure.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for armies, teams, schools and companies.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于军队、球队、学校、公司。

meaning.en: To stress keeping one's word and honouring promises.
meaning.zh: 重视守信用，说话算数。

examples.zh: 做生意要讲求信用，否则很难长久。
examples.en: In business you must value trustworthiness or you won't last.

examples.zh: 这家老店一向讲求信用，顾客都很放心。
examples.en: This old shop has always stressed good faith, so customers feel safe.

usage.en: Verb-object; chiefly in business and social-ethics contexts.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多用于商业和社会道德语境。

meaning.en: Working or living in a lax, undisciplined way.
meaning.zh: 做事和生活缺乏纪律，松松垮垮。

examples.zh: 他作风散漫，经常迟到早退。
examples.en: He is slack in his working style and often comes late and leaves early.

examples.zh: 作风散漫的团队很难打胜仗。
examples.en: An undisciplined team rarely wins.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used in evaluations and criticism of staff or soldiers.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于对员工、士兵的评价和批评。

meaning.en: Having good sources of information and hearing news early.
meaning.zh: 获得消息快，渠道多。

examples.zh: 他消息灵通，公司里的大小新闻都瞒不过他。
examples.en: He is well informed and no company news escapes him.

examples.zh: 据消息灵通人士透露，新手机下月发布。
examples.en: According to well-informed sources, the new phone will launch next month.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 消息灵通人士 is a stock expression in news (informed sources).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语；“消息灵通人士”是新闻中的固定说法。

meaning.en: Studying with great effort and perseverance.
meaning.zh: 学习用功，肯吃苦。

examples.zh: 他学习刻苦，每天晚上都读书到深夜。
examples.en: He studies hard and reads late into the night every evening.

examples.zh: 正是因为学习刻苦，她才考上了理想的大学。
examples.en: It was only by studying so hard that she got into her dream university.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical in school reports and testimonials.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常见于学校评语、先进事迹中。

meaning.en: Well organised, so that each point follows logically and is easy to follow.
meaning.zh: 层次和顺序清楚，容易看明白。

examples.zh: 他讲话条理清晰，大家一听就懂。
examples.en: He speaks in a clear, logical way and everyone gets it at once.

examples.zh: 这份报告条理清晰，重点突出。
examples.en: The report is well organised and highlights the key points.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (说得条理清晰); for speech, writing, thinking.
usage.zh: 作谓语或补语（说得条理清晰），用于说话、写作、思考。

meaning.en: Looking after someone with attention to every detail.
meaning.zh: 对人关照得细致全面。

examples.zh: 酒店对客人照顾周到，大家都很满意。
examples.en: The hotel looks after its guests attentively and everyone was pleased.

examples.zh: 多亏护工照顾周到，老人恢复得很快。
examples.en: Thanks to the carer's attentive care, the old man recovered quickly.

usage.en: Predicate, often 对…照顾周到 or 照顾得周到.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“对……照顾周到”或“照顾得周到”。

meaning.en: To come forward and help freely when someone is in need.
meaning.zh: 在别人需要时大方地给予帮助。

examples.zh: 多位热心市民慷慨相助，让患病的孩子筹到了医药费。
examples.en: Several kind residents generously helped, and the sick child raised the money for treatment.

examples.zh: 他在我最困难的时候慷慨相助，我一直记在心里。
examples.en: He helped me generously when I was in the worst trouble and I have never forgotten it.

usage.en: Usually a verb phrase with 的 or an adverbial in narrative; warm and formal in tone.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或叙述中的状语，语气温暖，较庄重。

natural: stay true to one's original aim

meaning.en: To hold to one's original purpose and not be swayed by changes or difficulties.
meaning.zh: 始终坚持最初的心愿和目标，不因环境变化而改变。

equivalents: stay true to one's original aim

examples.zh: 尽管历经波折，他仍不改初衷，继续做公益。
examples.en: Despite many setbacks he kept to his original purpose and carried on with charity work.

examples.zh: 她不改初衷，毕业后回到了家乡任教。
examples.en: She stayed true to her original wish and went home to teach after graduating.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows 历经/尽管 clauses; mildly formal.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常出现在“历经……”“尽管……”之后，略显庄重。
